integrity: Exact symbolic seven-parameter quartic polynomial identity and explicit normalized spherical moment formula; reproducible verification code and output embedded. No external certification.
scientific_limitations: For real degree-three spherical harmonics on S^2 only; sharp lower fourth moment and exact invariant deficit, no sharp upper bound, complex version, other degrees, or classification of rotation orbits. Historical octupole-invariant formulae may contain an equivalent identity. Publication priority and independent scientific audit are unverified.
title: Sharp least fourth moment and isotropy deficit for real cubic spherical harmonics
